title: Vocation Excellence Award
summary: RCMJ presented a Vocational Excellence Award to Ms. Geeta Chouhan.
description:
RCMJ presented a Vocational Excellence Award to Ms. Geeta Chouhan. Geeta Chouhan is an accomplished Indian wheelchair basketball player, having served as the Captain of the Indian Women’s Wheelchair Basketball Team from 2024 to 2026. She is also a National Para Athletics player and a member of the Maharashtra Women’s Wheelchair Basketball Team.
Under her leadership, the Maharashtra team has achieved remarkable success, winning five National Championship Gold Medals in 2018, 2019, 2023, 2024 and 2025. Her individual accolades include being the Top Scorer at the 2018 National Championship and receiving the Best Player of the Tournament Award in 2024.
